notes.title: 🎃HALLOWEEN EVENT !🎃
notes.content:
👻 New maps and environments: Explore haunted locations and areas specially decorated for Halloween. Grinning pumpkins, eerie fog, and spooky surprises await you around every corner!

🎉 Have fun in this festive world! Although this event doesn't offer specific modes or quests, the world of Sky Conquest has transformed to celebrate the season. Whether you're fighting or just exploring, the atmosphere is there to make every moment a little more... frightening.

🎃 Haunted decorations: Grinning pumpkins have popped up everywhere! They light up the game’s environments with their sinister smiles. But that's not all—spider webs, grim lanterns, and a misty ambiance cover the world to immerse you in the Halloween spirit.

notes.title: July 13 update notes ! 🔔🤩
notes.content:
- New funny hat ! 🎩
- New game mode : Sky Jump ! 😲
- New achievement : Sky Legend 👑
- Big optimization : Directx 12 + Nanite 🔥
- We receive the controllers players (Xbox Gamepad) 🎮
- We regret to inform you that the "Sky Bomber" mode is being repaired for technical reasons. 💣
- We've expanded the "hub" for future modes 😝
- New animations 😎
- New colored Sprint 🤩

notes.title: June 07 update notes ! 🤩
